title: Profile-First Before Org-Split
description: For orchestrated orgs, splitting the profile should be the FIRST consideration for resolving non-hard-limit issues. Profile splitting is cheaper, faster, and preserves data sharing, integrations, and reporting.

title: Hard Limits Require Org Splitting
description: Hard platform limits (custom object count, permission set count, Apex code size) cannot be overcome by new features or workarounds — only by org splitting, which gives a fresh set of limits.

title: Set Up Edge for Multi-Country
description: For multi-country orgs, set up Salesforce Edge to optimize network performance. Edge provides CDN and routing optimization for users in different geographies accessing a single org.

title: Consider Microservices for Limit Relief
description: When approaching platform limits, evaluate whether moving specific functionality to external microservices (e.g., complex calculations, high-volume processing, document generation) can reduce pressure on the org.

title: Align with Platform Strategy
description: Org strategy should align with the overall platform-of-platforms strategy. Consider how the CRM org fits into the broader ecosystem: Data Cloud, MuleSoft integration, Marketing Cloud, and Agentforce channels.

title: Decouple Org Decisions from Deployment Decisions
description: Don't link org strategy decisions with configuration/customization deployment or management decisions. The number of orgs should be driven by data, governance, and limits — not by deployment convenience.

title: Archive Data and Metadata Constantly
description: Proactive data archiving extends the life of a single org by keeping record counts below performance thresholds. Implement archiving strategy before limits are hit, not after.

title: Balance Agility with Efficiency
description: Give equal weight to agility and effectiveness over pure efficiency for certain business groups. Some LOBs need faster innovation cycles — don't sacrifice their speed for shared-org efficiency.

title: Map All Stakeholders
description: Understand the various stakeholders in the client environment before making org strategy decisions. Budget holders, IT governance, data architects, LOB leaders, and compliance officers all influence the decision.

title: Plan Storage for 3+ Years
description: Map out storage requirements for the next 3 years, including historical data loads from migration. Factor in: record growth rate, file attachments, email tracking, event records, and sample transaction history.

title: China Always Gets a Separate Org
description: Create a separate Salesforce org for China. This is a hard requirement driven by Chinese data residency laws, the Great Firewall, and network connectivity constraints. No exceptions.
